rights_safety.noassertion_effect: NOASSERTION records unresolved rights; it never grants copying, redistribution, publication, model-training, or derivative-work permission.
rights_safety.public_repository_rule: A file marked LOCAL_ONLY or PROHIBITED_PENDING_RIGHTS must not be committed, pushed, packaged, mirrored, or released through the public repository until documented rights and privacy review pass.
rights_safety.lawful_public_substitute: Use bibliographic citations, links to lawful sources, original paraphrases, claim-level notes, and non-reconstructive digests where full-text redistribution is not authorized.
rights_safety.owner_authority_limit: A repository owner decision, ADR, model review, or research classification cannot waive applicable law, contract, license, privacy, or third-party rights.
